expectations.text: 联网核验并列出来源台账，包含链接、时间、支持事实和可信度。
expectations.evidence: Report includes a source ledger table with URLs, timestamps/access times, supported facts, and credibility labels.

expectations.text: 覆盖官方赛程或比赛身份、名单状态、伤停停赛、可靠更衣室动态、历史交锋、近期状态和赔率。
expectations.evidence: Covers match identity, squad/list status, injury/suspension status, dressing-room/team context, head-to-head, recent form, and Oddschecker odds.

expectations.text: 明确声明专家会议是基于公开方法论的模拟分析席，不代表本人实时观点。
expectations.evidence: Includes the required simulated expert-room disclaimer before named expert views.

expectations.text: 章鱼保罗给出最可能比分、备选比分、胜平负倾向、信心等级、关键分歧点和最大反转变量。
expectations.evidence: Paul section includes most likely score, alternatives, 1X2 tendency, confidence, key disagreement, and reversal variable.

expectations.text: 真实正确比分赔率没有可靠来源时明确说明，且不编造赔率。
expectations.evidence: Uses Oddschecker for correct-score odds and records the update time rather than inventing numbers.

expectations.text: 包含仅供娱乐、不构成投注建议的声明。
expectations.evidence: Ends with the entertainment disclaimer and no betting advice.

uncertainties: Subagent completion notifications did not include token or duration data, so timing/tokens are not recoverable.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions were graded against the saved final_report.md outputs using deterministic human-authored evidence notes.
